feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 June 2026 12:15pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 19 June 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at times.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland and high pressure over continental Europe, with frontal zones affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 this afternoon, but always a force lighter in the southeast of the area. Occasionally 6 again early tonight, before veering west or southwest 3 or 4 later in the night.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough in the west, falling slight overnight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle, with areas of mist and isolated fog patches. Becoming fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain/drizzle/mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, quickly backing south or southwest, becoming variable 3 or less Saturday evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight soon becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
